He holds a black Samsung Galaxy Z Fold6 smartphone and speaks directly to the camera with expressive facial gestures. The background features bookshelves and a gold award plaque. (2) The scene cuts to a full-body shot of the same man wearing a large, green pea pod costume. He moves and dances awkwardly in a studio space with white walls. He has a playful expression as he looks toward the camera, contrasting with his previous professional appearance. (3) Back on the yellow sofa, the man continues his narrative while gesturing with his free hand. Digital overlays of mathematical formulas and equations appear briefly across the screen to emphasize his point. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting his features and the black smartphone. (4) Close-up shots focus on the foldable smartphone's large inner screen, which displays black-and-white manga pages from Hunter x Hunter. The man's fingers interact with the screen as he demonstrates the device's capabilities. A brief cutaway shows a hand applying makeup to his face. (5) A screen recording shows the smartphone's software interface. A user circles specific Japanese text on a manga page using the Circle to Search feature, triggering a Google search pop-up. The text is crisp and the interface appears smooth and responsive on the large display. (6) The man returns to the eye-level medium shot on the sofa. He gestures widely as he talks about his manga collection. Black and white filters are used for comedic effect during specific moments of his delivery. Several manga book covers are displayed as floating graphic overlays.
